32908e0.summary: Moves a card to the top of the player's or enemy's shuffled deck, then finishes the action: checks hero death, re-enables turn UI and scripted turns.

3291af8.summary: Decides whether an attack may resolve, checking attacker and target validity and attack state; logs and stores a cancel reason when not allowed.

3292594.summary: Returns true if the acting card has stomp, there are adjacent units, and the target's health is negative (overkill).

3292a78.summary: Builds a list of units in play that can cancel the given attack, excluding jam units and duplicates.

3292d2c.summary: Returns whether a player-owned minion card has a targeted effect that requires choosing a target (unless match data flags otherwise).

3292d88.summary: Returns the decrypted count of cards played this turn.

328e208.summary: Resolves a follow-up after a card resolution, then finishes the action: checks hero death, re-enables turn UI and scripted turns.

3292ebc.summary: Silently destroys a unit: removes it from play and minion manager, hides it, and strips hand effects tied to it as the enchanting card.

3292fac.summary: Queues an automatic reassemble-minions action for the given side at instant priority.

3293018.summary: Determines the unit death type from the action's cards, damage type and whose turn it is.

32927ac.summary: Broadcasts a unit-damaged event, logs the damage stat for the attacker, and raises a DamageSignal.

3293244.summary: Returns true when the match is a replay and replay playback is active, so animations can be skipped.

32932bc.summary: Returns the time to play an enemy card: 0.2 seconds when skipping replay animations, otherwise 0.6.

32933c8.summary: Returns the Transform anchor for an animation position option (hero, hand, deck, center, next minion slot) relative to the cards.

32938ec.summary: Loads and instantiates an animation prefab at the start parent, sets its scale, runs the callback and initializes its CardAnimController.

3293b60.summary: Like CreateAnim but resolves start and end transforms from the animInfo position options, then instantiates and initializes the animation controller.

328e838.summary: Activates and highlights the blood thirst effect on the action's card, then finishes the action: checks hero death, re-enables turn UI.

3293e00.summary: Handles the choose-card countdown: auto-selects a random card if none chosen, and at low counts clears the choice UI and confirms the selection.

328b284.summary: Cancels any in-progress card play, attack or targeting state, restoring the card to hand and clearing highlights; returns whether anything was cancelled.

3293f64.summary: Sets up and shows the choose-a-card menu for a resolution choice, handling replay auto-selection and the countdown timer.

32940b8.summary: Builds the list of choice options for a card by randomly drawing from the full pool up to max targets, topping up and sorting for humans.
